maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from payment processing fees, banking and payables services on transaction volume, not repairing or replacing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private merchants, ISOs, retailers, manufacturers and fintechs; revenue is card and payment fees from commercial transactions.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through merchant acquiring, ISO partners and platform sales; acquisitions (e.g., Sila, CFTPay) are occasional, not the main growth path.

mission_critical.reason: MX Merchant, payment processing, banking and embedded finance APIs are integrated into merchants' operations; switching means re-boarding and downtime risk.
